answer: Votes are bought from strangers, not minted: a head has weight only while zephyr receipts from payers outside its sable are live, each backed by locked reef. Self-paid zephyr folds into one sable. Persona k of that operator must add 2^(k-1) new outside payers, each locking 1 reef until the receipt dies. Honest start: one payer, 1 reef. Ten personas: 1023 unrelated reef locks; fresh wallets self-pay and vanish.
